notes.title: [Version update] Optimize model rendering; Optimize UI loading speed
notes.content:
1. Optimize the rendering of models, Add  "Alpha Clipping" option in the editing model. When some hair or clothing parts appear incomplete, please uncheck this option.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285093/712d863576f2856352cc78802ed85110ff7fa1c4.png[/img]


2. When there are too many models or dances in the Installed list, in the previous version, the speed of switching models or dancing UI was too slow or even stuck for about a second. 
After the deep optimization of this version, no matter how many models dance in the Installed list, it can be very smooth and instantly open in seconds. No more stuttering issues.

notes.title: [Version update 4.2] Added support for multiple playlists and cloud sync
notes.content:
1. Add support for multiple playlists:
(1) Click the "Playlist" icon in the round menu of the model, or click the "Playlist" button in the lower right corner of the main window to open the Playlist UI
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285093/975b588ab5bed196762ea3735141b1604751c1f7.png[/img]

(2) Create/Delete playlist at the bottom of the playlist UI, and Switch the playlist in the drop-down box
(3) Double-click a song in the playlist list to start playing, press the delete key on the keyboard or the right-click menu to delete a song
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285093/38f6e44932af32ea9426dd203d2d55a8f4bc1c15.png[/img]



2. Supports Steam Cloud Sync of Playlists: Steam will automatically sync the playlist list between your multiple computers.

notes.title: [Version Update] Added custom rotation and distance options for model
notes.content:
1. Add custom rotation option for model: Select any loaded model on the theater page, uncheck "Always face forward" on the right panel, and then you can freely set the rotation of the model in the x, y, and z directions .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285093/bb9ed31ede44a7bf590536e69a6521c776e62e5b.png[/img]

2. Add the distance option of model: Select any loaded model on the theater page, and adjust the model's distance option on the right panel.


3. Support directly dragging and rotating the model with the right mouse button: directly click and press  the model on the desktop with the right mouse button, and then drag the model horizontally to freely rotate the model; left mouse button double-click the model to restore the original rotation.

notes.title: [Version Update] Add lighting color option; Add "Boss Coming" hotkey.
notes.content:
1. In the previous version, the lighting was set to a yellowish and warmer sunlight color, so some users responded that the color of the model was yellowish, so the default lighting color was adjusted to white, and a new lighting color setting was added in the settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285093/27ef8e9c0f3dda4bfc36a425675f2f59a1c0f685.png[/img]


2. Add the  "Boss Coming"  hotkey : One-key to pause the song and hide all models, press it again to restore the display and then play music and dance, the default hotkey is Shift+Alt+S . And the software will automatically release all CPU and GPU usage when paused, so you can play the game without worrying about dropped frames. This  function can also be directly clicked on the tray right-click popup menu item "Hide All" to enable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285093/1f7463ce6a2f1c9b063fff0f4570d22555c39d22.png[/img]

notes.title: [Update]Added model default zoom setting, auto save current zoom as default
notes.content:
Added model default zoom setting, auto save current zoom as default
1. Edit the model to set the specialized zoom setting of the model.  
2. Whenever a model is closed, the current zoom size will be automatically saved as the default value, and this zoom will be used when the model is opened next time, avoiding the need to adjust the model zoom size every time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285093/5fe25472928fe62a8da8abbefb550f9df053cf7b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DesktopMMD4: Born to Dance Released Now! It's time for dance again now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42285093/45588b2b7bc21c150d10876d2d5e9cad1605f356.png[/img]

[h1]IT'S TIME FOR DANCE AGAIN NOW![/h1]
  DesktopMMD4 is mainly born to solve the clip through problem of the previous version of the model  and the inability to directly import VMD dance files. After more than a year of exploration, I finally found a new way and fully switched to the original MMD technology framework, which not only realized the ability to directly support the import MMD's VMD dance action files, and directly use the original MMD physics engine to dance without the problem of clip through the model, and even directly support the lip-sync and facial with the VMD dance, making it easier for the model to dance on the desktop with richer details.
  If you have purchased DesktopMagicEngine or DesktopMMD3 then it will be given to your library for free.


[h1]WHAT'S NEW[/h1]

(1) Support Directly import the VMD dance motion files of MMD without conversion, and supports the lip-sync and facial expressions .
(2) Support directly import the PMX/PMD model file of MMD without conversion and better compatibility .
(3) Support the physical effects of MMD, and no longer clip through model when dancing.
(4) Support switch two rendering styles of model with one click: 2D Anime rendering style and 3D  realistic rendering style.
(5) Support directly import the VPD action file of MMD without conversion.
(6) Support multiplayer motions in a  dance, allowing multiple models to load different VMDs to dance different motions.
(7) Brand-New lightweight rendering engine, which uses less system resources and reduces the GPU usage by as much as 60% compared with the previous generation.


[h1]VIDEO PREVIEW[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1968650/videos/?p=1&browsefilter=mostrecent
